items.title: HON. BABATUNDE SUNDAY OGUNLADE (BABS) UNVEILS THE VISION TO LEAD, CAPACITY TO DELIVER LEGISLATIVE BLUEPRINT FOR IBARAPA EAST 2027
items.summary: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade formally presented a strategic campaign brochure and legislative agenda focused on six core delivery pillars for Ibarapa East.
items.body:
ERUWA, OYO STATE — Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade (BABS), the All Progressives Congress (APC) candidate for the Oyo State House of Assembly (Ibarapa East Constituency), has formally unveiled the Vision to Lead, Capacity to Deliver legislative blueprint for Ibarapa East 2027.

The initiative outlines six strategic pillars designed to drive grassroots development, youth opportunities, better healthcare, educational advancement, infrastructure renewal, and inclusive governance in the constituency.

The presentation was made during a high-level engagement attended by community leaders, APC stakeholders, and key supporters, reflecting the candidate’s commitment to practical, people-centered representation.

Speaking at the event, Hon. Ogunlade emphasized that effective leadership means listening to the people, understanding local realities, and translating community needs into concrete action. He affirmed that his legislative agenda would prioritize development that is visible, measurable, and rooted in the aspirations of Ibarapa East residents.

The Vision to Lead, Capacity to Deliver brochure represents a roadmap for responsive legislation, accountable leadership, and sustainable community progress ahead of the 2027 election cycle.

The campaign continues to rally support around a clear message of service, unity, and development for Ibarapa East.

items.title: Ogunlade Assures Ibarapa East Residents of Inclusive Representation and Empowerment at Grand Finale of Ward Tour
items.summary: The APC candidate concluded his ward tour and emphasized direct community engagement, empowerment, and inclusive representation for all residents.
items.body:
The All Progressives Congress (APC) candidate for Ibarapa East State Constituency in the 2027 Oyo State House of Assembly election, Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade (BABS), has assured residents that his leadership will be defined by inclusive representation, direct engagement, and meaningful empowerment for every community.

Speaking at the grand finale of his ward tour, Hon. Ogunlade reiterated his commitment to listening to the people, understanding their pressing needs, and translating those concerns into action. The event brought together stakeholders, traditional leaders, youth groups, artisans, traders, and residents from across the constituency.

The candidate emphasized that development must not be limited to a few communities or groups, but must reach every ward, every household, and every class of people in Ibarapa East. He also highlighted the need for practical policies that improve education, youth opportunities, healthcare, infrastructure, and economic participation.

The warm turnout and strong reception from the people underscored the confidence and support building around his candidacy. Hon. Ogunlade expressed gratitude to the residents for their enthusiasm, trust, and solidarity, while reaffirming his determination to serve with accountability, compassion, and vision.

The tour concluded with a renewed resolve to carry the momentum of grassroots engagement into a stronger campaign for the future of Ibarapa East.

items.title: Ibarapa East Stands Firm with Progress as APC Leaders, Traditional Rulers and Community Stakeholders Unite Behind Vision for Development
items.summary: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade received the APC governorship and deputy governorship candidates during a high-impact consultative tour of Ibarapa East, with royal fathers, religious leaders, artisans, and community stakeholders affirming their support for a people-centered development agenda.
items.body:
ERUWA, OYO STATE — Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade, the All Progressives Congress (APC) candidate for Ibarapa East State Constituency, yesterday received the Party’s Governorship Candidate, Distinguished Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli, alongside the Deputy Governorship Candidate, Hon. Adesoji Adedeji, during a consultative tour across Ibarapa East.

The delegation was joined by key APC leaders and candidates, including Hon. Aderemi Abass Oseni, Senatorial Candidate for Oyo South Senatorial District, and Hon. Niyi Yusuf, Candidate for Ido/Ibarapa East Federal Constituency.

The high-level engagement featured consultative meetings with His Royal Majesty, Oba Samuel Adebayo Adegbola (Ajobo Olurin I), the Eleruwa of Eruwa; the Traditional Councils of Eruwa and Lanlate; the Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN); Muslim communities; artisans; tradesmen; and pensioners.

The consultative meetings served as a strong demonstration of unity, inclusion, and shared commitment to progress in Ibarapa East. The diversity of stakeholders present underscored the region’s readiness to align behind a vision that prioritizes practical development, transparent leadership, and inclusive governance.

Speaking on behalf of the people, Hon. Ogunlade thanked the royal fathers, religious leaders, community heads, and residents of Ibarapa East for their overwhelming warmth, enthusiasm, and support. He emphasized that the people of the constituency are fully aligned with the APC’s vision for a prosperous, inclusive, and forward-moving Oyo State.

The event reaffirmed the power of grassroots engagement and the importance of building a campaign anchored on people, service, and development. The people of Ibarapa East, he noted, are ready to stand firm with progress and to support leaders who are willing to work sincerely for the advancement of the constituency and the state.

The campaign remains committed to a clear agenda of active representation, community-first leadership, and sustained development for the people of Ibarapa East.

E kaabo si Ibarapa East, Senator!

Signed:
Honourable Babatunde Ogunlade
APC Candidate (OYSHA), Ibarapa East State Constituency
